source: .omc/research/gemini/gemini-usecases.md section 'CubiCasa evaluation (n=30, held-out)'; raw data and request log in .omc/research/gemini/experiments/ (cc30/, request_log.jsonl, purpose prefix CC30). Copied by L1; not re-run.

selection.rule: images with both a door and a window count question; the 3 images used earlier excluded

detection.request: experiments/e2g_req.json, temperature 0, JSON, default resolution, one call per image

tile_check_as_filter.verdict: made exact counts worse (12/30 under the frozen rule); NOT used as a filter on raster

score_prior.served_in_app: Since 14 Nov: image-only (raster) uploads answer bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, separate WC room, sauna, toilet, sink, shower/bathtub, storey and balcony counts from one Decisions score request per drawing (aura/gemini/score.py), with this evaluation's intro text, question wording and 0-6 levels. Difference from the evaluation: the live request carries only these 10 score questions (the evaluation request also carried door/window and other questions). Doors and windows are never answered by score.

gate_G1.rule: door and window recall >= 0.8 and exact >= 60 % (n=30)
gate_G1.outcome: not met: windows 56.7 % exact, both below 60 % once reweighted; recall not measurable
gate_G1.decision: raster UI not built; raster answers are API-only behind the presenter token, labelled a model estimate; no tile-check filter on raster

tiled_detection_paired.note: paired exploration on 12 CC30 images (2x2 tiles, 20 % overlap); not a new held-out estimate. Fill from gemini-usecases.md section 'Tiled detection, paired test (n=12)' when complete.

detection_n40.run: Few-shot paired test, baseline arm = frozen CC30 prompt (production pipeline), random.seed(2028)
detection_n40.note: stratified in the dataset's style mix: 2 colorful, 8 high_quality, 30 high_quality_architectural (75 % architectural sheets)

few_shot_arm.verdict: no gain (within noise, direction negative); not adopted

detection_pooled.note: CC30 (n=30) + the n=40 baseline arm: two held-out samples of the same production prompt
